🎃HALLOWEEN UPD!

🧩🎉Welcome to WORDIE where you have to guess a 5 letter word in 6 attempts.

Guess the hidden word in six tries, guided by color-coded clues: green for correct letters in the right spot, yellow for correct letters in the wrong spot, and grey for incorrect letters. Challenge yourself and see how many words you can solve! 🧠

😊Most Relaxing Game on Roblox

👍If you like the game please consider giving a thumbs up and a favorite, it helps me a lot!
